authority_note: Proposal only. ARCS Verify owns verifier output: finding names, states, routing and reason codes. arcs-srs ships no SCITT verifier; none of the required cases below has been executed against ARCS Verify.
evaluation_unit: one finding set per exact target-artifact–Signed Statement–Receipt relationship, keyed by their SHA-256 digests within the selected evaluation context; the Receipt digest alone identifies only the proof artifact

evaluation_identity.digest_source: SHA-256 recomputed from the actual exact bytes, not unvalidated carrier claims; R01/R02 precede deduplication. If target bytes are absent, preserve the entry and report subject binding not_evaluated without reusing a complete finding set.
evaluation_identity.context_scope: Identify or scope the selected proof (including which proof within a Receipt), proof profile/version, verifier implementation/version/configuration, selected issuer/service keys and trust inputs/policy, and time policy/inputs to the evaluation. Changed context requires independent evaluation; absent context is explicit, never a wildcard. No global identifier or persisted schema is required.
evaluation_identity.complete_result_reuse: only when all three digests and the complete evaluation context match
evaluation_identity.repeated_receipt_different_relation: evaluate independently; do not skip a pairing or transfer an earlier PASS/FAIL when the statement or target artifact differs
evaluation_identity.evidence_counting: repeated proof bytes are not an independent source; duplicate-count suppression must not suppress a failed relationship
evaluation_identity.cache_boundary: Reuse only work invariant for the actual cache inputs. Inclusion and Receipt-signature checks depend on the root reconstructed from the selected statement and proof; statement, subject and trust findings must not escape their evaluation context.

preconditions.rule: R01 and R02 apply before any finding. When either applies, every finding for the entry is not_evaluated; each finding's not_evaluated_when lists only the conditions beyond these.

findings.question: Is this statement about these exact receipt bytes?
pass_requires: payload_hash_alg is -16 (SHA-256)
payload_preimage_content_type is application/json
the embedded payload equals the SHA-256 of the exact receipt bytes
sub equals the RFC 6920 ni URI of that digest
not_evaluated_when: the exact receipt bytes are not supplied

findings.question: Does the statement stay inside this binding's statement profile?
pass_requires: a well-formed COSE_Sign1 with no duplicate map keys
a protected header holding only allowlisted labels
alg present
kid, x5t or x5chain present
CWT Claims holding only iss and sub
label 3 absent from both headers
labels 258, 259 and 260 absent from the unprotected header
an empty unprotected header
an embedded payload

findings.question: Did the named statement issuer sign it?
pass_requires: the COSE_Sign1 signature verifies under a verifier-selected key for iss
not_evaluated_when: no verifier-selected key exists for iss

findings.question: Does this entry's Receipt prove inclusion of this exact statement?
pass_requires: the Receipt is well formed for its proof profile
the verifier recomputes the inclusion root from the statement and the proof
the Receipt's signature verifies over that recomputed root under a verifier-selected service key
not_evaluated_when: the verifier does not support the Receipt's data structure

findings.question: Is there an authenticated registration time?
pass_requires: registration_receipt_inclusion passes
the selected proof profile defines a registration time covered by the Receipt's verified signature
the verifier's selected time policy accepts it
not_evaluated_when: the proof profile defines no authenticated registration time

routing.condition: no registration is supplied for the receipt
a carried byte field fails base64url decoding, or its SHA-256 differs from the carried digest
routing.effect: every finding for that entry is not_evaluated, and no content is read

routing.condition: after R01/R02, all three recomputed digests in evaluation_identity and the complete evaluation context match another entry
routing.effect: evaluate that complete relationship once; report SCITT_DUPLICATE_ENTRY and add no independent evidence. The same Receipt with a different statement or target artifact is evaluated independently, preserving failed pairings and order-independent results; a changed context is also evaluated independently. Per-entry hints and their disagreements remain reportable.

routing.condition: the statement is not well-formed CBOR, is not a COSE_Sign1, or has duplicate map keys
routing.effect: registration_statement_profile, registration_subject_binding, registration_statement_signature and registration_receipt_inclusion fail

routing.condition: a protected label outside the allowlist, label 3 in either header, label 258, 259 or 260 in the unprotected header, a non-empty unprotected header, CWT claims beyond iss and sub, no alg, no key reference, or a detached payload
routing.effect: registration_statement_profile fails; the other findings are evaluated independently

routing.condition: the payload, sub, payload_hash_alg or payload_preimage_content_type does not match the exact receipt bytes
the statement signature does not verify under the selected key for iss
the Receipt is malformed, lacks headers its proof profile requires, or carries a critical header the verifier does not understand
the Receipt's signature verifies but the inclusion root was not recomputed from the statement
the recomputed inclusion proof does not match the statement
an authenticated time assertion fails verification or is rejected by the time policy
a time value appears only outside the Receipt's signature, or only in the sidecar
routing.effect: the value is reported as unauthenticated; registration_time_authenticated is not_evaluated unless an authenticated assertion also exists

routing.condition: a carrier hint disagrees with authenticated evidence
routing.effect: the disagreement is reported; no finding changes

reported_values.source: the verified Receipt and the matched trust material

required_cases.note: Requirements for the verifier owner, not executed against a native binding verifier here. Local carrier-shape tests and a constructed cryptographic relation-key model probe this proposed contract only; they do not establish native conformance or acceptance of these cases.

binding_specific.case: the statement carries a Receipt or any other value in its unprotected header
swap entry order for S1/P and S2/P about the same artifact, with valid statement signatures and P including S1 but not S2
binding_specific.expected: every finding set is unchanged under the full relation and context key: registration_receipt_inclusion passes for S1/P and fails for S2/P in both orders; neither pairing is suppressed by R03

binding_specific.case: repeat the same artifact/statement/Receipt relationship and context (including entries with differing hints); also vary the artifact, selected proof, proof profile, verifier, trust policy or time policy
binding_specific.expected: identical relationships and context are evaluated once with SCITT_DUPLICATE_ENTRY (R03), never counted as an independent source; exact duplicate JSON entries fail schema uniqueItems. Changed relation or context is evaluated independently; duplicate-count suppression never hides a failed pairing; hint disagreements remain reportable (R13)

binding_specific.case: the service hint names service A, but the Receipt verifies under service B's key
binding_specific.expected: the findings name service B; the disagreement is reported (R13)

binding_specific.case: a valid Receipt from service A beside an invalid Receipt from service B
binding_specific.expected: inclusion passes for A and fails for B; neither result is attributed to the other

binding_specific.case: a trusted service A beside an untrusted service B
a time value in the Receipt's unprotected header is altered
binding_specific.expected: inclusion is unchanged; the value is reported as unauthenticated and supports no time bound (R12)

binding_specific.case: an extra protected header carries receipt content
label 258, 259 or 260 in the unprotected header
duplicate keys in the protected header map
CWT Claims carry a claim other than iss and sub
a carried digest differs from its carried bytes
carried bytes are not valid base64url
sub carries the receipt_id instead of the digest's ni URI
a Receipt with no authenticated registration time
binding_specific.expected: registration_time_authenticated is not_evaluated; inclusion is unaffected
